comment: Testrunner example for cross-deployment calls in one slot. Matching call/receive permitters live on the test bootstrap overlay and use ${testDeploymentId} so the runner can rewrite them to the live slot id. The receiver uses trigger.deploymentAccess; the caller uses sendToStep(accessId, stepId, body). This is the same-slot stand-in for a two-deployment call/receive pair (see integration-testing/deployment-access-group-multimember-routing for a real multi-bootstrap case).

resultsProcessor.script: var response=context.sendToStep('same-slot-callers','echo-stub',JSON.stringify({ping:true}));if(response.isErrored()){throw new Error(String(response.getAllErrors()[0]));}var body=JSON.parse(response.getBody()||'{}');if(body.pong!==true){throw new Error('unexpected echo body: '+JSON.stringify(body));}console.log('same-slot-sendtostep-ok');context.sendMetric('same-slot-sendtostep-ok', 1.0);context.setBody(JSON.stringify(body));
